test_vectors.coverage: Null, both booleans, negative zero, exponent spelling, empty strings, external whitespace, scalar payload indices, and empty numeric cache.
Exact preorder tags, container records, immediate child counts, exclusive subtree ends, parent links, sibling links, and full raw container spans.
Empty objects and arrays, nested empty containers, sentinel first-child values, zero-length cooked keys and values, and quoted raw key spans.

Whitespace and comma prefixes, escaped ASCII keys, raw multibyte UTF-8, paired surrogates, mixed raw and decoded references, exact cursor reference preservation, retained arena bytes, and document clone ownership.
Integer spellings beyond u64 and i64, extreme positive and negative exponents, and signed decimal zero without machine-number conversion.
Escaped quotes and backslashes in keys, every short JSON string escape, escaped slash, NUL, U+001F, exact raw preservation, and cooked scalar counts.
Strict rejection of decoded-equivalent keys with absolute error offsets and preservation of every duplicate when explicitly allowed.

Empty and truncated inputs, missing values, trailing commas, extra roots and suffix bytes, invalid number grammar, unclosed strings, invalid escapes, lone surrogates, invalid UTF-8, and unescaped controls. Full errors are compared against direct cursor traversal.
Inclusive and zero payload, nesting, array-item, object-field, number-digit, string-byte, and decoded-arena limits.
512 nested arrays and 257 immediate scalar children, with complete structural invariant assertions.
Zero, maximum valid node index, reserved u32 sentinel, usize overflow boundaries, and deterministic Vec capacity failure mapped to BudgetExhausted without exhausting memory.
Escaped quotes, empty keys, reversed and out-of-bounds committed ranges, missing quotes, empty input, and maximum u32 offsets.

Unmatched and mismatched closes, absent object keys, multiple roots, unresolved cooked references, inconsistent scalar counts, absent string references, overflowing spans, and invalid delimiter offsets.

status.validation: Manual source review only. No build, compiler, formatter, check, or test commands were run, as instructed.
status.integration: Uses the frozen jmax-cursor walk::from_payload, walk::next, and resume::finish interfaces. Finalization transfers the original cursor payload and decoded arena without rebasing offsets.
status.from_validated: Consumes and discards foreign parts and proof, releases foreign tables before construction, and reparses only the payload under the supplied limits. No proof is fabricated. A runtime fixture was not created because issuing ValidationProof requires unsafe code and the DOM contract forbids unsafe code.
status.ownership: Only crates/jmax-dom/src/build.rs and reports/wave1/W1-15.json were written.
